intro: Writing about names, birthdays, astrology, baby names or self-discovery? Give your readers something to try. These free calculators work on any website or blog: paste two lines of code where you want the widget to appear. They are lightweight, mobile friendly, collect no personal data and need no signup.

faq.q: Are the numerology widgets really free?
faq.a: Yes. They are free to use on any site, including commercial blogs. We only ask that you keep the small credit link.

faq.q: Do the widgets collect my readers' data?
faq.a: No. All calculations happen in the reader's browser. Nothing they type is sent to NameAligned or stored.

faq.q: Will a widget slow my page down?
faq.a: The script is small and loads asynchronously, so it does not block your page from rendering.

faq.q: Which numerology system do the widgets use?
faq.a: Chaldean numerology, the sound-based system. Name numbers use Chaldean letter values; birthday and personal year numbers use date digits.
